subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: What permanent Docker-outside-of-Docker host-path contract should OpenClaw support for sandbox workspace and skill bind sources?
rationale: The central fix changes sandbox bind-source trust and operator setup behavior, and the repository policy treats sandbox/config/setup changes as security- and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Approve validated remapping
options.body: Add a shared host-path remap mechanism before Docker bind validation and container creation, covering workspace, skills, browser, and custom binds with docs and live proof.

options.title: Require path parity
options.body: Keep runtime simple by requiring identical host/container workspace paths, then add setup/doctor checks and clearer Docker docs so invalid DooD layouts fail early.

options.title: Narrow to materialized skills first
options.body: Limit the next fix to the open materialized-skill path and leave broader workspaceAccess and custom-bind host mapping as separate follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Approve validated remapping
recommendation.body: Add a shared host-path remap mechanism before Docker bind validation and container creation, covering workspace, skills, browser, and custom binds with docs and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already marked this issue canonical and have recent Docker/sandbox history relevant to the boundary decision.
